(()=>{window.CV=(tr,n)=>{if(window._vt!==tr){PT8.launch({rally:true,circuit:true,mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[]});window._vt=tr}const T=RACE.T,N=T.N,wr=a=>{while(a>Math.PI)a-=2*Math.PI;while(a<-Math.PI)a+=2*Math.PI;return a};const cv=[];for(let i=0;i<N;i++)cv.push(Math.abs(wr(T.psi[(i+5)%N]-T.psi[(i-5+N)%N]))/(10*T.sp));const pk=[];for(let i=0;i<N;i++){let m=1;for(let d=-25;d<=25;d++)if(cv[(i+d+N)%N]>cv[i])m=0;if(m&&cv[i]>.012)pk.push(i)}const k0=pk[n%pk.length],k=(k0-22+N)%N;const cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60,16/9,.1,3000);cam.position.set(T.x[k],T.y[k]+4,T.z[k]);cam.lookAt(T.x[k0],T.y[k0],T.z[k0]);window.drawRace=()=>R.render(RACE.scene,cam);return pk.length+':'+k0};return 1})()
